title: fix: align sandbox UI with dashboard design
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Sandbox creation and actions now use the shared dashboard dialogs, dropdowns, and buttons; Kill retains its confirmation dialog. The template menu shows built-in template prices, while a custom E2B template’s hourly cost appears on its card after startup because E2B reports sizes only for team-built templates. The create dialog stays open during creation, and an unknown template appears under its name instead of sending the user to an error page. The insufficient-balance message says “Not enough Pollen to pay for the next 10 minutes.” and links to Pollen. Blue preview badges clarify future runtime, while payment, limits, and SSH guidance remain on the main page.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art dashboard garden, Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; small-to-medium in the scene and wearing a tiny tool belt, she points to a sandbox template menu with simple price tags beside a lime green (#ecf874) code-plant. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with a warm cream background, lavender and peach accents, dark purple (#110518) outlines, chunky sprites, and subtle CRT glow.
